errors.text_span: 绿色实线带三角标记的曲线
errors.evidence: The description identifies the markers for both the Rest14 and Twitter datasets as "三角标记" (triangle marker) but fails to distinguish between the downward-pointing triangles for Rest14 and the upward-pointing triangles for Twitter, making the description ambiguous.
The description states the accuracy for the Twitter dataset at a window size of 10 is approximately 75.9%, but the data point on the graph is visibly lower, at approximately 75.7%.
